summary: A realtime 2v2 on Comet Catcher: our two Opus 5.5 medium seats on the east edge (t2 at G1, t3 at H8) under an Opus commander, against u6bkep (19) and Covariance (17), both Armada, who opened with a Rover mass (65 Rovers died in the game) and switched to Blitz packs from about 6:20. Both seats opened late (plants standing at 1:26 and 1:35 on three solars, 13 and 10 factory units by 4:00 against the pool's 17-22) with no turret at home, and the Rovers took t3's home spots at 2:03-2:31 while its own Rovers had been put on rove, then 11 Rovers burned t2's home at 3:33-4:25 while its six Blitzes walked west under a packet that called home raids not their business. The Rover mass broke on our homes by 5:30 and the side climbed back to about 9 extractors, but t2's army went west at 6:37, killed 270 metal at C3 and died at B3, and at 7:20 eight Blitzes and two Rovers killed t2's commander at F1 while its home guard, merged into another group by the hands, chased one Blitz across the map. The people's Blitz packs grew to 15-25, t2's plant died at 9:15 and t2 was out by 9:49, and t3's commander stood at 1% with ten Blitzes on it when the record ends at 10:07. Only one enemy base (B8) was ever seen, and neither seat held more than 6 extractors (a duel side in the pool holds 11-15 by 6:00-8:00).

root.what: The people's Rover opening reached homes with no turret and with their soldiers sent elsewhere. At t3 the player's rove (ordered 1:51, landed 1:57) took its two Rovers off the first raid; spot_77, a constructor and spot_65 died 2:03-2:31 and t3 stood at 1 extractor by 3:00. The same shape cost t2 4 extractors, 3 constructors and 2 solars at 3:33-4:25 (turning point 2). From 2:00 on, when both seats were level with the pool at 3 extractors, the side never held more than 6 extractors a seat. The earliest avoidable moment is the opening itself (plant at 1:07/1:16 on three solars, the first Sentry at t3 2:35, at t2 5:38); the user's own review picked 1:58 (t3) and 3:30 (t2), the reader the shared shape.

their_play: Both people played Armada vehicles from the west (one plant seen, at B8, its commander at B8 2:55, C8 5:41, D7 6:33, D6 8:42; the second base never seen, guessed A1-A5). They opened with a Rover mass: 1-3 Rovers in t3's base at 1:51, 6-7 by 2:31, the same seven out of sight across the middle 3:06-3:33 and then 11 on t2's home, swarms of 14-17 at t3 4:34-5:31; 65 Rovers died in all, 48 by 5:50, but they took 9 extractors, 5 constructors, 3 solars and 3 Sentries of ours by 5:40. Their outer spots carried Sentries (B3, B5 two, A4, A6, C3, C5, D4, B7). From about 6:20 they switched to Blitzes (first at t3's spot_75 6:21): packs of 4-8 at 6:45-7:58, the 8 Blitzes and 2 Rovers that killed t2's commander at F1 7:20, 13-15 at t2's plant 8:52-9:31, 15-25 in t3's base 9:13-10:07. No tier 2 seen. They fought in our half all game (seat 0's metal-lost-by-place has theirs 2,772 in our half and 2,893 at our base); the only units of ours near the B8 base were scout Rovers (armfav_28488 445 from it at 2:59, armfav_2847 831 at 6:16), and t2's raid reached their outer spots at C3/B3 only (6:52-7:50).

bears_on.note: Lost on extractors, not on the trade: 22 extractors lost in ten minutes (12 at t2, 10 at t3), never more than 6 a seat, while fights near our homes killed 109 of theirs.

The people's first handful crossed the map: Rovers in t3's base by 1:51 and on t2's by 3:33. Ours went on rove or stayed home: one scout Rover killed a Sentry at A6 at 3:36 and died there, and the next kills of theirs came at C3 at 6:52-6:56 (pool: first building killed 2:48 median).
Our side was the one with naked extractors: no Sentry at t2's home until 5:38. Both raids ran there.

In people's hands a Rover mass paid against bases with no turret: 65 Rovers (about 2,000 metal) for 9 extractors, 5 constructors, 3 solars and 3 Sentries by 5:40, and the economy gap. The lesson's 'needs specific micro' holds for our attempt, not theirs.
Commander 8:50: 'we keep meeting them three Blitzes at a time'. t2's raid split at 6:47 (4 of 9 back), and the transfer that tried to make one body landed mid-fight.
They did it to us: 8 Blitzes and 2 Rovers caught t2's commander at F1, away from its Sentries, at 7:20.
3,891 metal of wrecks at our homes by 8:00 and 5,324 by 10:00, with '0 at work' in every minute's wreck line, while income sat at 4-12 a seat.
Three solars with the fast constructor as the plant's first unit (t2 1:37, t3 1:46), but the plant stood at 1:26 and 1:35, against the pool's 0:53.
